plan.title: Treated vs control lung DE under confounded batch
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a 12,000 x 12 raw salmon gene-level count matrix (counts.csv, gene symbols in column 1) with a 12 x 3 sample table (metadata.csv: sample, condition, batch), 6 treated vs 6 control lung samples in Homo sapiens. The decisive design fact from the profile is that batch B1 contains all 6 controls and B2 all 6 treated samples — processing batch is PERFECTLY confounded with condition. No statistical method can separate treatment effect from batch effect in this design: ~condition + batch is rank-deficient and will not fit, and any batch-correction step (ComBat, removeBatchEffect, SVA) applied here would either remove the treatment effect entirely or, worse, launder the batch effect into an apparently clean treatment signal. The plan therefore does NOT attempt batch adjustment; it runs the only estimable model (~condition), reports every effect as condition+batch combined, and spends real effort quantifying how much of the signal could be technical.

T1S1 loads the two CSVs, verifies the confounding by cross-tabulating condition against batch, filters low-count genes, applies VST, and produces PCA/sample-correlation/library-size diagnostics — establishing what the separation looks like without claiming to attribute it. T1S2 runs DESeq2 with design ~condition (treated vs control, control as reference), with apeglm/ashr shrunken LFCs, and returns the full ranked result table plus BH-FDR calls; the same contrast is repeated with edgeR-limma-voom as a method-robustness check, since a hit that only one framework finds is weaker still under this design. T1S3 is the sensitivity work that makes the deliverable honest: leave-one-sample-out and split-half stability of the top genes, a permutation null over the 6v6 labels to see how many 'hits' the data yields under label shuffling, and an explicit check of whether the DE set is enriched for genes with the technical signatures batch typically drives (GC/length-correlated shifts cannot be tested without annotation, but library-size- and detection-rate-associated genes can). T2S1 takes the ranked list into hallmark and GO-BP enrichment using the staged human MSigDB GMTs — reported as a description of the combined condition+batch axis, not as treatment biology. Every downstream artifact must carry the confounding caveat in its text output so that no summary reads these genes as treatment-attributable.
